reference_sql:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
)
SELECT CAST(event_ts AS DATE) AS session_day, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM gaps
WHERE (prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes')
  AND event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-06 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY CAST(event_ts AS DATE)
alternatives:
WITH gaps AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    LAG(event_ts) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS prev_ts
  FROM app_events
), flagged AS (
  -- one row per app event
  SELECT user_id, event_ts,
    CASE WHEN prev_ts IS NULL OR event_ts - prev_ts > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM gaps
)
SELECT CAST(event_ts AS DATE) AS session_day, SUM(new_session) AS sessions
FROM flagged
WHERE event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-06 00:00:00+00'
GROUP BY CAST(event_ts AS DATE)
HAVING SUM(new_session) > 0

SELECT CAST(e.event_ts AS DATE) AS session_day, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM app_events e
WHERE e.event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND e.event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-06 00:00:00+00'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM app_events p
    WHERE p.user_id = e.user_id
      AND (p.event_ts < e.event_ts OR (p.event_ts = e.event_ts AND p.event_id < e.event_id))
      AND p.event_ts >= e.event_ts - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
  )
GROUP BY CAST(e.event_ts AS DATE)

SELECT CAST(e.event_ts AS DATE) AS session_day, COUNT(*) AS sessions
FROM app_events e
WHERE e.event_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND e.event_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-06 00:00:00+00'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM app_events p
    WHERE p.user_id = e.user_id
      AND (p.event_ts < e.event_ts OR (p.event_ts = e.event_ts AND p.event_id < e.event_id))
      AND p.event_ts >= e.event_ts - INTERVAL '30 minutes'
  )
GROUP BY CAST(e.event_ts AS DATE)
other_way.tradeoff: NOT EXISTS finds the events with no earlier event of the user in the 30 minutes before, which reads well but runs slower than LAG.

solver.query:
WITH f AS (SELECT event_id, user_id, account_id, event_ts, event_name, CASE WHEN LAG(event_ts) OVER w IS NULL OR event_ts - LAG(event_ts) OVER w > INTERVAL '30 minutes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS ns FROM app_events WINDOW w AS (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id)),
s AS (SELECT *, SUM(ns) OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY event_ts, event_id) AS sn FROM f),
ss AS (SELECT user_id, account_id, sn, MIN(event_ts) AS st, MAX(event_ts) AS en, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY user_id, account_id, sn) SELECT CAST(st AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS DATE) AS session_day, COUNT(*) AS sessions FROM ss WHERE st >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-01 00:00:00+00' AND st < TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-12-06 00:00:00+00' GROUP BY 1
